title: Five Winter Landscapes for Saxophones
catalog_decision: Not added: complete contents and edition unverified

confirmed_components.title: White Morning Stillness
confirmed_components.observations: Printed heading Five Winter Landscapes for Saxophones, I, TENOR, with composer date 1990. Opening Largo at quarter note 48–52 in 4/4, quiet solo entrance over independent piano voices. Only opening page inspected.

confirmed_components.title: Windswept Snowscapes
confirmed_components.observations: Printed heading Five Winter Landscapes for Saxophones, II, ALTO. Opening page inspected during batch 12. Removed as a standalone catalog entry at Tim’s request.

confirmed_components.title: Ski Trail Through the Birches
confirmed_components.observations: Actual cover says From Five Winter Landscapes and soprano saxophone and piano. First solo-part page inspected: Andante at quarter note 84, initially 4/4; sustained slurred melody, chromatic notes and later sixteenth-note runs with changing meter. No movement number verified. Copyright 1991 is not a composition date.

other_leads.title: Twilight Pine Shadow
other_leads.status: Publisher catalog verifies the separate baritone/piano title only. Membership in Five Winter Landscapes is unverified.
